test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2d884c4de8d8bd2cd691a9cc6ff6995467342cda085d08e7256dab81bb2ebcb.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Given figure is shifted rotated one step in the second figure, then rotated two steps in the third figure, then rotated three-step in the fourth figure, and finally rotated four steps in the final figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccac5254c503686bb7f59d822559198c7291b3da1f417705952338c7a9101c0b.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
